header: Sensex, Nifty and a watch list of shares, from Yahoo Finance's public chart feed (one small request per symbol, kept five minutes on the server, so the load on the source is light). Prices there may be delayed (about fifteen minutes) and the card says so. "Trending" means the biggest movers of a FIXED WATCH LIST of large companies (SAIL among them), not of the whole market: I made the card name the list instead of claiming more. This is market data, never advice. This file is pure: the feed's JSON goes in, the numbers come out (tested on a hand-made sample of the feed's documented shape; a live check needs the source to be answering).

doc: Tells whether the last price is from the trading session now. NSE and BSE trade 9:15 to 15:30 IST on weekdays, and I treat a price older than 20 minutes as the last close.

behaviours: a quote: price, previous close, change and percent to two places
the day's prices for the line, with the gaps (null) left out
the time of the last price is read as that instant
an answer without a usable price is nothing, never a guess
a long day is thinned to about 40 points, ending on the last price
movers: the three biggest risers and the three biggest fallers, only those that moved
movers: a flat day has none
what could not be fetched is named, and the rest is shown
nothing fetched at all is an error
the lists: Sensex, Nifty 50, Nifty Bank; SAIL first of the watch list; symbols unique
session: a fresh price during trading hours on a weekday is live; the same price after 3:35 pm, or at the weekend, is the last close
